paper.title_en: Thermodynamics of arbitrary spherical surfaces in FLRW spacetimes
paper.abstract_en: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamics of arbitrary spherically symmetric surfaces in non-flat FLRW spacetimes within general relativity. Adopting the gravity-to-thermodynamics perspective, the Clausius relation and the unified first law follow directly from the gravitational field equations and matter dynamics, with a central role played by the matter-flux measure derived from energy-momentum conservation. The cosmological apparent-horizon and event-horizon thermodynamics are both recovered as special cases. In particular, the event-horizon temperatures derived from the gravitational dynamics satisfy both thermodynamic relations without introducing phenomenological modifications, and the corresponding temperature reduces to the Gibbons-Hawking temperature in the de Sitter limit. We further show that previous inconsistencies originate from incompatible temperature prescriptions rather than from any intrinsic deficiency in the thermodynamics of the cosmological event horizon. These results demonstrate that the gravity-thermodynamics correspondence is a generic feature of gravitational dynamics rather than a property unique to causal horizons.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文将引力-热力学对应关系从因果视界推广到非平坦FLRW时空中的任意球对称曲面，统一了Clausius关系与统一第一定律，并把宇宙学视界与事件视界热力学作为特例恢复，还论证了既往不一致源于温度规定不兼容。对广义相对论基础与视界热力学研究者有明确的点击价值。
decision.title_zh: FLRW时空中任意球面上的热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们在广义相对论框架下研究非平坦FLRW时空中任意球对称曲面的热力学。采取从引力到热力学的视角，Clausius关系与统一第一定律直接由引力场方程和物质动力学导出，其中由能量-动量守恒导出的物质通量测度发挥核心作用。宇宙学表观视界与事件视界热力学均作为特例被恢复。特别地，由引力动力学导出的事件视界温度同时满足两个热力学关系，而无需引入现象学修正，并且相应温度在de Sitter极限下约化为Gibbons-Hawking温度。我们进一步表明，先前的不一致源于互不相容的温度规定，而非宇宙学事件视界热力学存在任何内在缺陷。这些结果表明，引力-热力学对应关系是引力动力学的一个普遍特征，而非因果视界所独有的性质。
